title: deploy workflow pulled origin/main on the box: a 'successful' deploy-branch run left the box on the old code (observed 4/28)
tier_reason: the observed 4/28 no-op was caught within minutes, but every deploy-branch run from 4/22 to 4/28 applied code only if origin/main had also been pushed; whether any earlier run was a silent no-op (leaving a believed-live fix undeployed) is unknown until the box reflog (deploy_history.txt, B1) is read

contract.text: A successful deploy run installs exactly the commit pushed to the deploy branch on the box before restarting services and running the canary.
contract.source: commit 1eb432d message body; commit a5af424 message body; CLAUDE.md Deployment

mechanism.text: the deploy step ran `git pull --ff-only` on the box checkout, which tracks main, so it fetched origin/main; `git push origin main:deploy` advances only origin/deploy, so unless main was also pushed the pull was a no-op while the services still restarted and the canary passed on the old code

verified_recovered.how: 4e221c8 body: the health-checks subpackage (e74c485, among the commits the 11:06 no-op left undeployed) ran its first end-of-day cycle that evening, so the box had the new code

residual.text: `git reset --hard origin/deploy` read the mutable ref at execution time, so an in-flight run could ship a later queued commit its own gate never tested; closed 7/10 by resetting to the run's tested $TARGET_SHA (30452eb, round-3 F2).

watchdog.trigger: a deploy run concludes success but the box HEAD recorded after the run (deploy_history reflog / 'Deployed <sha>' log line) differs from the run's head SHA
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the box HEAD equals the pushed deploy SHA and the restarted services report that SHA

evidence.what: observed 4/28 11:06 ET: pushed main:deploy with 6 new commits, the workflow reported success in 45 s, but the box HEAD stayed at the pre-push SHA (verified with git log on the box)

notes: exposure window 4/21 19:03 ET (1eb432d) to 4/28 15:15Z: every deploy-branch run in between depended on origin/main having been pushed; operator reports on 4/22-4/24 (E33 polling, E35 NRestarts baseline, E36 blank cell) indicate those deploys did apply code
tier_pending settles on deploy_history.txt (B1, the box reflog) - if it shows HEAD moving at each 4/22-4/25 run, B; any run with no HEAD move is a silent no-op
